The artifact covers the only two restaurants on the Saint-Tropez peninsula with 2+ Michelin stars in the 2026 Guide — both confirmed in the March 2026 Guide Michelin France ceremony:

- **La Vague d'Or** (3★, in Saint-Tropez) — Arnaud Donckele, from €445/person, dinner 5 nights/week, 6-month waitlist
- **La Voile** (2★, Ramatuelle, 10 km south) — Éric Canino, €245 tasting menu, open daily May–Oct
